A critically acclaimed game to be sure, but there are technical issues to address in the PC version of The Blood of Dawnwalker - from its somewhat optimistic recommended specs to the intrusive stutter we noted even on a Ryzen 9 9950X3D paired with an RTX 5090. Rebel Wolves suggests that an upscaled 1440p at 60fps is possible on an Nvidia RTX 4060 - but we don't quite agree, so to what extent can optimised settings make a difference?
